item.title: South Korea and U.S. to Hold Follow-Up Talks on Nuclear Submarines and Nuclear Fuel Reprocessing on February 2-3 (한미, 내달 2~3일 원잠·핵연료 재처리 후속 협의 들어간다)
item.description:
South Korea and U.S. to Hold Follow-Up Talks on Nuclear Submarines and Nuclear Fuel Reprocessing on February 2-3 (한미, 내달 2~3일 원잠·핵연료 재처리 후속 협의 들어간다)

The first meeting between the two countries' interagency delegations will take place to discuss South Korea’s introduction of nuclear-powered submarines (NPSS) and the issue of securing rights for uranium enrichment and reprocessing of spent nuclear fuel. This comes approximately six months after the release of the "Joint Fact Sheet" last November, which outlined agreements between the South Korean and U.S. leaders. (한국의 원자력 추진 잠수함(원잠) 도입과 우라늄 농축, 사용 후 핵연료 재처리 권한 확보 문제를 논의하기 위한 양국 범정부 대표단 간의 첫 회의가 열린다. 지난해 11월 한미 정상 간의 합의 사항을 담은 ‘조인트 팩트시트’가 발표된 지 약 6개월 만이다.)

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs announced on the 29th that a kick-off meeting for follow-up consultations on the security sector of the South Korea-U.S. Joint Fact Sheet will be held in Seoul on February 2-3. The U.S. State Department stated that Under Secretary of State for Political Affairs, Alison Hooker, will lead an interagency delegation to South Korea from February 1-3 to advance the nuclear energy cooperation initiative agreed upon at the South Korea-U.S. summit last October. (외교부는 29일 한미 조인트 팩트시트의 안보 분야 후속 조치 협의를 위한 발족(kick-off) 회의가 다음 달 2~3일 서울에서 열린다고 밝혔다. 미국 국무부는 앨리슨 후커 정무차관이 지난해 10월 한미 정상회담에서 합의된 원자력 협력 이니셔티브를 진전시키기 위해 범정부 대표단을 이끌고 다음 달 1~3일 방한한다고 밝혔다.)

The South Korean side will be represented by First Vice Foreign Minister Park Yoon-ju, along with officials from the Office of National Security at the Presidential Office, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Ministry of National Defense, the Ministry of Climate and Energy, the Ministry of Science and ICT, the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy, and the Nuclear Safety and Security Commission. From the U.S., in addition to Under Secretary Hooker, officials from the White House National Security Council (NSC), the State Department, the Department of Energy, and the Department of Defense will visit South Korea. (우리 측에서는 박윤주 외교부 1차관과 청와대 국가안보실, 외교부, 국방부, 기후에너지부, 과기정통부, 산업통상부, 원자력안전위원회 등 관계자로 구성된 범정부 대표단이 이번 회의에 참석한다. 미국에서는 후커 차관 외에 백악관 국가안보회의(NSC), 국무부, 에너지부, 전쟁부 등 관계자도 방한할 예정이다.)

This marks the first face-to-face meeting between interagency delegations from South Korea and the U.S. since the agreement on South Korea's introduction of nuclear-powered submarines was reached at last October's summit. The delay in security follow-up consultations resulted from the U.S. raising issues over delays in South Korea's $350 billion investment in the U.S. and the treatment of American companies, including Coupang. (지난해 10월 한미 정상회담에서 한국의 원잠 도입 등이 합의된 후, 한미 양국의 범정부 대표단이 얼굴을 마주하는 것은 이번이 처음이다. 미국 측이 우리 측의 3500억달러 대미(對美) 투자 지연과 쿠팡을 포함한 미국 기업에 대한 대우에 문제를 제기하면서 안보 후속 협의가 지연된 결과다.)

At this meeting, discussions are expected to cover procedures for acquiring U.S. low-enriched uranium (LEU), which will serve as fuel for South Korea's nuclear-powered submarines. The agenda is also anticipated to include amendments to the current South Korea-U.S. nuclear cooperation agreement, which prohibits South Korea from reprocessing spent nuclear fuel and requires U.S. approval through high-level consultations even for uranium enrichment to levels below 20%. (이번 회의에서는 한국 원잠의 연료가 될 미국 저농축 우라늄(LEU) 획득 절차 등이 논의될 전망이다. 한국의 사용후핵연료 재처리를 금지하고 20% 미만 저농도로 우라늄을 농축할 때도 한미 고위급 협의를 통해 미국의 승인을 받도록 규정한 현행 한미 원자력 협정의 개정 문제도 의제로 예상된다.)

In this context, the U.S. State Department stated that Under Secretary Hooker will discuss various bilateral and global issues to strengthen the South Korea-U.S. alliance, including cooperation in security and economic sectors. Topics may include the transfer of wartime operational control (OPCON), investment in the U.S., and the Coupang issue. Under Secretary Hooker met with First Vice Minister Park during his visit to the U.S. on the 19th (local time) and mentioned "continued progress on trade and industry partnerships" and "the need to ensure fair treatment for U.S. companies and swiftly resolve market entry barriers." (이런 가운데 미 국무부는 후커 차관이 안보와 경제 분야 협력을 포함해 한미 동맹을 강화하기 위한 다양한 양자 및 글로벌 현안을 논의할 것이라고 밝혔다. 전작권 전환이나 대미 투자, 쿠팡 문제 등이 논의될 가능성이 있다. 후커 차관은 지난 19일(현지 시각) 방미한 박 차관을 만나 “무역·산업 파트너십의 지속적 진전”과 “미국 기업에 대한 공정한 대우 보장과 시장 진입 장벽의 조속한 해결 필요성”을 언급했었다.)

item.title: Failure to Unify in Pyeongtaek B, Attacks Among Same-Leaning Candidates (단일화 못한 평택을, 같은 진영 후보끼리 공격)
item.description:
Failure to Unify in Pyeongtaek B, Attacks Among Same-Leaning Candidates (단일화 못한 평택을, 같은 진영 후보끼리 공격)

In the Pyeongtaek B by-election, as all five candidates from the ruling and opposition camps failed to unify ahead of early voting, attacks within each camp against their own candidates have persisted. (경기 평택을 재선거에서 여야 후보 5명이 모두 사전투표 전 단일화에 실패한 가운데, 각 후보를 향한 진영 내 공격도 계속되고 있다.)

Kim Yong-nam, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate, cast his early vote in Pyeongtaek's Anjung-eup on the 29th and told reporters, "For elections to remain the flower of democracy, hate politics and dirty tricks must disappear," adding, "The negative campaigning from the opposing side has reached its peak." This was seen as a jab at allegations raised by Cho Kuk, the Jo Kuk Innovation Party candidate, regarding the purported operation of a loan shark under a borrowed name. Cho issued a statement that day, saying, "Let the citizens of Pyeongtaek achieve unification through their votes." Previously, Kim and Kim Jae-yeon, the Progressive Party candidate, had opposed a pan-opposition unification, while Cho alone expressed support. (김용남 더불어민주당 후보는 29일 평택 안중읍에서 사전투표를 한 뒤 기자들과 만나 “선거가 민주주의의 꽃으로 계속 남기 위해서는 혐오 정치와 공작 정치가 사라져야 한다”며 “최근 상대 측의 네거티브 공세가 극에 달하고 있다”고 했다. 조국 조국혁신당 후보 측의 대부업체 차명 운영 의혹 제기 등을 겨냥한 것으로 해석됐다. 조 후보는 이날 입장문을 내 “평택시민이 투표로 단일화를 이뤄달라”고 했다. 앞서 김 후보와 김재연 진보당 후보는 범여권 단일화에 반대했지만, 조 후보만 찬성 의사를 밝힌 바 있다.)

Cho Seung-rae, the Democratic Party's Secretary-General, earlier claimed, citing bank transaction records, that allegations of Kim Yong-nam operating a loan shark were not true. However, within the opposition, criticism has emerged that the suspicions have not been fully resolved. Yoo Si-min, former chairman of the Roh Moo-hyun Foundation, said on a pro-opposition YouTube channel that day, "The party secretary-general saying all doubts about (Kim's) allegations have been cleared is a challenge to party members' sovereignty and a disregard for the people. If the (national) election had been a close call, Kim would have been cut off already." Yoo had previously stated, "It would be better for South Korea if Cho is elected." (조승래 민주당 사무총장은 앞서 예금거래내역서 등을 근거로 김용남 후보의 대부업체 운영 의혹은 사실이 아니라고 주장했다. 그렇지만 여권에선 이에 대해 의혹이 완전히 해소되지 않았다는 비판이 나오고 있다. 유시민 전 노무현재단 이사장은 이날 친여 유튜브에서 “당의 사무총장이 (김 후보 의혹을) 소명이 다 됐다고 얘기하는 건 당원 주권에 대한 도전이자 국민을 무시하는 것”이라며 “(전국) 선거가 아슬아슬했다면 김 후보를 벌써 잘랐을 것”이라고 했다. 유 전 이사장은 앞서 “조 후보가 당선되는 것이 대한민국에 낫다”고 하기도 했다.)

Hwang Kyo-ahn, the Liberty and Innovation candidate, wrote on Facebook that day, "Please, this time, vote on June 3rd, election day itself. I earnestly beg you." This was interpreted in political circles as a consideration for a possible last-minute unification with Yoo Ui-dong, the People Power Party candidate, as well as an effort to encourage supporters skeptical of early voting to cast their ballots on election day. Yoo appealed for conservative unity on Facebook, saying, "If we pool our strength, we can win for sure." (황교안 자유와혁신 후보는 이날 페이스북에 “이번에는 제발 6월 3일 당일에 투표해달라. 간곡히 부탁드린다”고 했다. 이를 두고 정치권에선 유의동 국민의힘 후보와 막판 단일화 가능성을 염두에 둔 것이라는 해석과 함께, 사전투표에 부정적인 지지층들에게 본투표를 독려한 것이라는 해석이 나왔다. 유 후보는 페이스북에서 “우리가 힘을 모으면 확실하게 승리할 수 있다”며 보수 결집을 호소했다.)

item.title: Seoul Mayor TV Debate Turns Heated Over “Debate Avoidance” Claims (‘토론 도망 달력’까지 등장… “왜 피하냐”로 싸운 서울시장 TV토론)
item.description:
Seoul Mayor TV Debate Turns Heated Over “Debate Avoidance” Claims (‘토론 도망 달력’까지 등장… “왜 피하냐”로 싸운 서울시장 TV토론)

In a televised debate among candidates for Seoul mayor on June 3, which concluded just five hours before early voting began on the 28th, the controversy over “debate avoidance” emerged as a key issue. Although People Power Party candidate Oh Se-hoon and Reform Party candidate Kim Jeong-cheol had repeatedly requested debates, Democratic Party candidate Jeong Won-oh refused, resulting in only this single TV debate among the candidates in the Seoul mayoral election. (지난 28일 사전 투표 개시 5시간 전에 끝난 6·3 서울시장 후보 TV 토론에서 ‘토론 회피’ 논란이 쟁점 중 하나가 됐다. 그간 국민의힘 오세훈, 개혁신당 김정철 후보가 수차례 토론을 요청했지만 더불어민주당 정원오 후보가 거부하면서, 이번 서울시장 선거에서 후보 간 토론회는 이날 TV 토론회 한 번으로 끝났다.)

During the debate, Kim Jeong-cheol held up a placard labeled “Jeong Won-oh’s Debate Evasion Calendar” and launched an attack on Jeong. In the session focused on “labor,” Kim stated, “I personally marked every date Jeong turned down debate proposals,” adding, “I see Jeong as a defective product in politics.” He further argued, “We cannot entrust the lives of 10 million Seoul citizens to such a flawed commodity.” (이날 토론에선 김정철 후보가 ‘정원오의 토론 도망 달력’이라고 적힌 패널을 들고 나와 정 후보를 공격했다. 김 후보는 ‘노동’을 주제로 한 주도권 토론 시간에 “정 후보가 토론 제안을 회피한 날짜마다 제가 직접 기입했다”면서 “(정 후보는) 정치계의 불완전 판매라고 생각한다”고 했다. 그는 “1000만 서울시민의 삶을 이렇게 부실한 상품에 맡길 수 없다”고도 했다.)

The calendar held up by Kim indicated that Jeong had rejected debate proposals 15 times in April and May, with the word “evasion” written on it. In reality, since candidate debates became more common, it is rare to see only one debate held in a Seoul mayoral election. (김 후보가 꺼내 든 달력에는 정 후보가 4~5월 토론 제안을 15차례 거부했다면서 ‘도망’이라는 문구가 적혀 있었다. 실제 후보 토론회가 활성화된 이후로 서울시장 선거에서 후보 간 토론회가 한 번 열린 것은 전례를 찾기 어렵다.)

Jeong strongly countered these claims. He retorted, “If you call this a debate, it’s obvious it would be filled with baseless slander and negativity unrelated to the topic—I don’t understand why you’d do this.” (이에 대해 정 후보는 강하게 반발했다. 그는 “토론을 했다고 한다면 바로 이렇게 주제와 관계없는 흑색선전, 네거티브로 점철될 게 뻔한데 왜 그렇게 하는지 모르겠다”고 했다.)

In this first and only TV debate of the election, candidates Jeong Won-oh, Oh Se-hoon, Kim Jeong-cheol, and Green Justice Party candidate Kwon Young-guk clashed over issues such as housing policy, the missing rebar incident at the GTX-A Samsung Station construction site, and the controversy over the donation of a “shaman shrine” called “Baby Shrine.” (처음이자 마지막인 이날 TV 토론회에서는 정원오·오세훈·김정철 후보, 정의당 권영국 후보가 부동산 정책, GTX-A 삼성역 공사 현장의 철근 누락 사태, ‘아기씨당’ 굿당 기부채납 의혹 등 현안을 놓고 공방을 벌였다.)

In his opening remarks, Oh said, “I’ve given my all over the past five years,” adding, “A city ranked third globally in ‘quality of life city competitiveness’ is within reach. I want to complete it overwhelmingly.” In contrast, Jeong argued, “Please judge Oh Se-hoon’s decade of incompetence,” and pledged, “I will safely and reliably support the lives of citizens.” (오 후보는 시작 발언에서 “지난 5년 동안 사력을 다해 왔다”며 “세계 3위의 ‘삶의 질 도시 경쟁력’ 도시가 눈앞에 있다. 꼭 압도적으로 완성하고 싶다”고 했다. 반면, 정 후보는 “오세훈 후보의 10년 무능을 심판해 달라”면서 “제가 시민의 삶을 안전하고 든든하게 뒷받침하겠다”고 했다.)

The two candidates sparred over housing and real estate policies. Jeong claimed, “During (Oh’s tenure as Seoul mayor) from 2022 to 2024, only 39,000 housing units were supplied based on groundbreaking—less than half of what he promised. Why blame your predecessor or the government?” Oh countered, “The previous mayor (Park Won-soon) dissolved 389 redevelopment zones. They tore everything up and sprayed herbicide, and I’m working to restore it.” (두 후보는 주택·부동산 정책을 놓고 언쟁을 벌였다. 정 후보는 “(오 후보가 서울시장이던) 2022~2024년 착공 기준 (주택) 3만9000호를 공급했다. 본인이 약속한 것의 절반도 못한 것”이라며 “왜 전임자 또는 정부 탓을 하는가”라고 했다. 그러자 오 후보는 “전임 (박원순) 시장 시절 (정비 사업 구역을) 389곳 해제했다”며 “전부 갈아엎고 제초제를 뿌려놓고 나갔는데 그것을 원상 복구하고 있는 것”이라고 맞받았다.)

Oh brought up allegations surrounding the “Baby Shrine” (a shamanistic shrine) that arose during Jeong’s tenure as Seongdong-gu district chief, concerning the redevelopment of Hangdang 7 District. In the past, Seongdong-gu allowed a redevelopment association to construct a shaman shrine building and planned to receive its ownership as a donation, but after completion, the ownership was not transferred due to regulatory violations. Oh alleged this constituted preferential treatment. When Oh asked, “Was it because of an improper connection with the Baby Shrine that you couldn’t clearly resolve this?” Jeong retorted, “That’s clearly false. Will you take responsibility for that?” (오 후보는 정 후보가 성동구청장으로 재직할 때 행당7구역 재개발 추진 과정에서 제기된 ‘아기씨당’(무속신당) 의혹을 꺼냈다. 과거 성동구는 한 재개발 조합의 굿당 건물 신축을 허가해주며 그 소유권을 기부채납받기로 했는데, 완공 이후 규정 위반을 이유로 소유권을 이전받지 않았다. 결과적으로 특혜를 줬다는 것이다. 오 후보가 “아기씨당과의 유착 관계가 있기 때문에 명확하게 정리를 못한 것인가”라고 묻자, 정 후보는 “명백한 허위사실이다. 책임지겠는가”라고 반박했다.)

Jeong attacked Oh over the missing rebar incident at GTX. Jeong said, “The Seoul city director in charge stated that the missing rebar at GTX Samsung Station was not a major fault and that they didn’t even report it to the (then) Mayor Oh. Is this typical poor construction, or is it a serious case of poor construction?” Oh replied, “After consulting experts, they determined the structural integrity was sufficient to continue construction, and they said they’d come up with supplementary measures. It’s not something I can address in black-and-white terms.” (정 후보는 GTX 철근 누락 사태를 갖고 오 후보를 공격했다. 정 후보는 “서울시 담당 본부장은 ‘GTX 삼성역 철근 누락이 중대 과실이 아니’라며 ‘(당시 오세훈) 시장한테 보고도 안 했다’고 한다”며 “본부장의 판단처럼 일반적인 부실 시공인가, (아니면) 중대한 부실 시공인가”라고 물었다. 이에 오 후보는 “전문가 의견을 들어보니 공사를 계속할 정도의 강도가 유지된다고 판단했고, 공사를 하면서 보완 방안을 마련했다고 한다”며 “일도양단적으로 말씀드릴 일이 아니다”라고 했다.)

When Jeong pressed further, saying, “Your inability to give a clear answer is a sign of safety negligence,” Oh responded, “You keep using safety issues as campaign material. I won’t be drawn into your strategy.” Additionally, when Jeong stated, “Oh still hasn’t visited the Samsung Station construction site,” Oh replied, “What good would my visit do to resolve the situation?” (정 후보가 재차 “명확하게 말 못하는 것이 안전 불감증”이라고 몰아붙이자 오 후보는 “(안전 문제를) 자꾸 선거용 소재로 쓰고 있다. 전략에 말려들지 않겠다”고 했다. 또 정 후보가 “오 후보는 아직도 삼성역 공사 현장에 가보지 않았다”고 하자 오 후보는 “제가 가는 게 (사태 수습에) 무슨 도움이 되는가”라고 했다.)

Regarding the recent Seosomun collapse incident, both Jeong and Kwon Young-guk criticized Oh simultaneously. Jeong argued, “If we properly inspect and address issues in advance, we can prevent safety accidents,” while Kwon said, “It’s been reported that Seoul city completely cut the budget for fall prevention nets at the Seosomun construction site when drafting the budget. This is very concerning.” (최근 발생한 서소문 붕괴 사고와 관련해서는 정 후보와 권영국 후보가 동시에 오 후보를 비판했다. 정 후보는 “미리 잘 점검하고 보완한다면 안전사고 막을 수 있다”고 했고, 권 후보는 “서울시가 예산을 짤 때 (서소문 공사 현장) 추락 방지망 예산을 완전히 삭감했다고 한다. 매우 우려스럽다”고 했다.)

item.title: Jeonnam Records Highest Early Voting Rate at 22.3%, Daegu Lowest at 9% (사전투표율 전남 22.3% 최고, 대구 9% 최저)
item.description:
Jeonnam Records Highest Early Voting Rate at 22.3%, Daegu Lowest at 9% (사전투표율 전남 22.3% 최고, 대구 9% 최저)

On the first day of early voting for the June 3 local elections, the National Election Commission announced that 5,180,486 out of 44,649,908 eligible voters cast ballots at 3,571 polling stations nationwide, resulting in a voter turnout of 11.6%. This is 1.42 percentage points higher than the highest first-day early voting rate for local elections in 2022, which was 10.18%. (6·3 지방선거 사전 투표 첫날인 29일 전국 3571개 투표소에서 유권자 4464만9908명 중 518만486명이 투표해 11.6%의 투표율을 기록했다고 중앙선거관리위원회가 밝혔다. 지방선거 첫날 사전 투표율 중 가장 높았던 2022년(10.18%)보다 1.42%포인트(p) 높다.)

Among the 17 cities and provinces, Jeonnam recorded the highest turnout at 22.31%, followed by Jeonbuk (19.39%), Gangwon (14.37%), and Gwangju Metropolitan City (14.19%). Jeonnam also had the highest first-day early voting rate in the 2022 local elections, at 17.2%. Conversely, the lowest turnout was in Daegu, which recorded 9.02%. Seoul, one of the key battlegrounds between the ruling and opposition parties, saw a turnout of 11.22%. (이날 17개 시도 가운데 가장 높은 투표율을 기록한 곳은 전남으로 22.31%였다. 그다음 전북(19.39%), 강원(14.37%), 광주광역시(14.19%) 순이었다. 2022년 지방선거 당시 사전 투표 첫날 투표율이 가장 높았던 곳도 전남(17.2%)이었다. 반면 가장 낮은 지역은 9.02%로 집계된 대구였다. 여야 접전지 중 하나인 서울의 투표율은 11.22%였다.)

If similar trends continue through the early voting period, which ends on the 30th, the final national early voting rate is expected to exceed 20%. In previous local elections, the final early voting rates were 11.49% in 2014, 20.14% in 2018, and 20.62% in 2022. However, the first-day early voting rate this time fell short of the level seen in last year's presidential election. The highest first-day early voting rate in any nationwide election was recorded during the 2025 presidential election, at 19.58%. (30일까지 이어지는 사전 투표에서 비슷한 추세가 이어진다면 전국의 최종 사전 투표율은 20%를 넘어설 것으로 예측된다. 역대 지방선거에서 최종 사전 투표율은 2014년 11.49%, 2018년 20.14%, 2022년 20.62%였다. 다만 이날 사전 투표율은 작년 대통령 선거 수준에는 미치지 못했다. 전국 단위 선거에서 첫날 사전 투표율이 역대 가장 높았던 건 2025년 대선으로, 19.58%를 기록했었다.)

In the by-elections for the National Assembly, held concurrently with these local elections, the first-day early voting rate stood at 12.07%. The electoral district with the highest voter turnout as of this day was Gunsan, Gimje, and Buan-eul in Jeonbuk (24.8%), where nearly a quarter of eligible voters had already cast their ballots on the first day of early voting. The lowest turnout was in Asan-eul in South Chungcheong Province, recorded at 8.16%. Early voting continues on the 30th from 6 a.m. to 6 p.m., and voters can participate by visiting a nearby polling station with their identification. The locations of early voting stations can be found on the National Election Commission's website or through portal sites. (이번 지방선거와 동시에 치러지는 국회의원 재·보궐선거의 첫날 사전투표율은 12.07%를 기록했다. 이날까지 투표율이 가장 높은 선거구는 전북 군산·김제·부안을(24.8%)로, 유권자의 4분의 1 가까이 되는 인원이 사전 투표 첫날 투표를 마쳤다. 가장 낮은 곳은 8.16%로 집계된 충남 아산을이었다. 사전 투표는 30일 오전 6시부터 오후 6시까지 진행되며, 신분증을 가지고 가까운 투표소에 가면 참여할 수 있다. 사전투표소 위치는 중앙선관위 홈페이지나 포털사이트에서 확인 가능하다.)

item.title: Jeong Cheong-rae: “We Must Judge Pro-Insurrection Forces” Jang Dong-hyuk: “We Must Stop the Lee Government’s Dictatorship” (정청래 “내란 옹호 세력 심판을” 장동혁 “李정부 독재 막아야”)
item.description:
Jeong Cheong-rae: “We Must Judge Pro-Insurrection Forces” Jang Dong-hyuk: “We Must Stop the Lee Government’s Dictatorship” (정청래 “내란 옹호 세력 심판을” 장동혁 “李정부 독재 막아야”)

On the 29th, the first day of early voting for the June 3 local elections, both the ruling and opposition parties launched efforts to encourage turnout, each championing “national stability” and “checking the supermajority ruling party,” respectively. The Democratic Party of Korea and the People Power Party are pouring all their resources into boosting voter turnout among their supporters from the early voting stage. As the number of competitive battleground districts narrows the margin between candidates in the final stretch, both parties see the turnout of their supporters and undecided voters as a key factor determining victory or defeat. (6·3 지방선거 사전 투표가 시작된 29일 여야는 각각 ‘국정 안정론’과 ‘거대 여당 견제론’을 내세우며 투표 독려에 나섰다. 더불어민주당과 국민의힘은 사전 투표 단계에서부터 지지층의 투표율을 끌어올리는 데 총력을 기울였다. 선거 막판 여야 후보 지지율이 좁혀지는 접전 지역이 늘면서 여야 모두 지지층과 부동층의 투표율이 승패를 가를 변수가 될 것으로 보고 있다.)

Jeong Cheong-rae, acting leader of the Democratic Party, cast his early vote at the Seongsan 2-dong Community Center in Mapo-gu, Seoul, on the morning of the 29th, then said, “I sincerely hope you will vote. A vote is mightier than a bullet.” In a subsequent meeting of the central election committee, he added, “To all citizens and Seoulites who support President Lee Jae-myung, please come to the polls,” and urged, “If the KOSPI has risen and your stock accounts are showing profits, lifting your spirits, please cast your vote for Democratic Party candidate number one.” (정청래 더불어민주당 대표는 이날 오전 서울 마포구 성산2동 주민센터에서 사전 투표를 한 뒤 “꼭 투표하시길 바란다. 투표는 총알보다 강하다”고 했다. 그는 이후 중앙선거대책위원회 회의에서도 “이재명 대통령을 지지하시는 모든 국민, 서울 시민들께서는 투표장에 나와 달라”며 “코스피가 상승해 주식 계좌에서 이익을 보거나 계좌를 보며 마음이 흐뭇한 분들이 계신다면 민주당 기호 1번에 투표해 달라”고 했다.)

That day, the Democratic Party also revived its “judgment of insurrection forces” narrative alongside the “support for the Lee Jae-myung government” stance. Representative Jeong visited the Moran Market in Seongnam, Gyeonggi Province, with Gyeonggi gubernatorial candidate Choo Mi-ae and Seongnam mayoral candidate Kim Byung-wook, stating, “Park Geun-hye, who was impeached for state affairs meddling and the candlelight revolution, and Lee Myung-bak, who went to prison for corruption, are walking around” and “We must defeat the ‘Yoon Again’ campaign dreaming of reviving the insurrection leader Yoon Suk Yeol and judge the party that supports insurrection.” He also remarked, “The ‘prison trio’ is running amok.” This is seen as a strategy to maximize voter turnout among core supporters. (민주당은 이날 ‘이재명 정부 지원론’과 함께 ‘내란 세력 심판론’도 다시 꺼내 들었다. 정 대표는 추미애 경기지사 후보, 김병욱 성남시장 후보와 경기 성남 모란시장을 찾아 “국정 농단과 촛불 혁명으로 탄핵된 박근혜, 부정 부패로 감옥에 갔다 온 이명박이 걸어 다니고 있다”며 “내란 우두머리 윤석열 부활을 꿈꾸는 ‘윤어게인’을 물리치고 내란 옹호 정당을 심판해야 한다”고 했다. 그는 “‘감옥 3인방’이 설치고 있다”고도 했다. 핵심 지지층의 투표 참여를 최대한 유도하려는 전략으로 분석됐다.)

Democratic Party floor leader Han Byeong-do cast his early vote in Namwon, North Jeolla Province, on the same day, then visited Pungnam Gate Square and the Hanok Village with North Jeolla gubernatorial candidate Lee Won-taek to appeal for support. With a close race emerging in the Democratic Party’s stronghold of North Jeolla between candidate Lee and independent Kim Kwan-young, who was expelled from the party, Floor Leader Han has been visiting the Honam region for five consecutive days as of today. (한병도 민주당 원내대표는 이날 전북 남원에서 사전 투표를 한 뒤 이원택 전북지사 후보와 함께 풍남문 광장, 한옥마을을 찾아 지지를 호소했다. 민주당 ‘텃밭’인 전북에서 이원택 후보와 민주당에서 제명된 무소속 김관영 후보가 접전 양상을 보이면서 한 원내대표는 이날로 5일 연속 호남을 찾았다.)

The leadership of the People Power Party also worked to encourage early voting on the 29th. Policy Committee Chairman Jeong Jeom-sik cast his early vote in Tongyeong, South Gyeongsang Province, alongside Tongyeong mayoral candidate Cheon Young-ki, then wrote on Facebook, “From the early voting stage, our party has formed a ‘Fair Election Secure Voting Committee’ to ensure voters can exercise their precious rights with peace of mind, carefully overseeing the entire voting process.” Floor Leader Song Eon-seok plans to cast his early vote in his district of Gimcheon, North Gyeongsang Province, on the 30th. (국민의힘 지도부도 이날 사전 투표를 독려하고 나섰다. 정점식 정책위의장은 이날 오전 경남 통영에서 천영기 통영시장 후보와 함께 사전 투표를 한 뒤 페이스북 글에서 “국민의힘은 사전 투표 단계부터 안심하고 소중한 주권을 행사하실 수 있도록 ‘공명선거 안심 투표위’를 구성해 투표 과정 전반을 각별히 챙기고 있다”고 했다. 송언석 원내대표는 30일 지역구인 경북 김천에서 사전 투표를 할 예정이다.)

Acting leader Jang Dong-hyuk said during a campaign rally for the Sejong City mayoral election, “Everything depends on your one vote. If we don’t act, if we don’t go to the polls, nothing changes.” He added, “Even losing by one vote means defeat,” and urged, “Please go to the polls to stop dictatorship.” (장동혁 대표는 이날 세종시장 선거 지원 유세에서 “모든 것은 여러분의 한 표에 달려 있다”며 “행동하지 않으면, 투표장에 가지 않으면 아무것도 일어나지 않는다”고 했다. 이어 “1표 차로 져도 패배한다”며 “독재를 막기 위해 투표장에 가 달라”고 했다.)

However, Acting Leader Jang plans to vote on the main election day, June 3, rather than in the early voting. An opposition figure noted, “This seems to be a move aimed at some conservative supporters who distrust early voting.” Senior Spokesperson Park Seong-hoon said that day, “To strategically encourage both early voting and main voting, a division of roles within the leadership was necessary.” (다만, 장 대표는 사전 투표가 아닌 다음 달 3일 본투표를 할 예정이다. 야권 관계자는 “사전 투표를 불신하는 일부 보수 지지층을 위한 행보 같다”고 했다. 박성훈 수석대변인은 이날 “전략적으로 사전투표와 본투표를 적극 독려하기 위해 지도부의 역할 분담이 필요했다”고 했다.)

Among the People Power Party candidates for regional leadership, half participated in early voting on the 29th. The rest plan to vote on the main election day. A party official said, “We plan to focus on encouraging early voting in regions where targeting moderate and undecided voters is more needed, while concentrating on urging main voting in areas where consolidating the conservative base is a priority.” (국민의힘 광역 단체장 후보들 중에서는 절반이 이날 사전 투표에 참여했다. 나머지는 본투표를 하겠다는 계획이다. 당 관계자는 “중도·부동층 공략이 더 필요한 지역은 사전 투표 독려에, 보수 지지층 결집에 주력해야 할 지역은 본투표 독려에 당력을 집중할 예정”이라고 했다.)

Lee Jun-seok, leader of the Reform Party, cast his early vote in his district of Hwaseong, Gyeonggi Province, on the 29th. Cho Kuk, leader of the Rebuilding Korea Party, who is running in the by-election for the National Assembly seat in Pyeongtaek, Gyeonggi Province, also cast his early vote there. (이준석 개혁신당 대표는 이날 지역구인 경기 화성시에서 사전 투표를 했다. 경기 평택을 국회의원 재선거에 출마한 조국 조국혁신당 대표는 평택에서 사전 투표를 했다.)

Polling experts noted, “While supporter turnout is important, the votes of undecided voters in the final stretch can also sway the election results.” According to polls released just before the ban on publishing survey results (on the 28th), the percentage of undecided voters in battlegrounds like Seoul, Busan, and Daegu was around 20%, similar to six months before the election. A political source commented, “If the margins between candidates remain tight in competitive races, it’s highly likely that interest in the election will increase and the turnout rate among undecided voters will rise.” (여론조사 전문가들은 “지지층 투표율도 중요하지만, 막판 부동층 표심도 선거 결과를 좌우할 수 있다”고 했다. 여론 조사 결과 공표 금지(28일) 직전 공개된 여론조사에서 서울·부산·대구 등 격전지 부동층 비율은 선거 6개월 전과 비슷한 20% 안팎으로 나타났다. 정치권 관계자는 “여야 후보 지지율이 좁혀져 접전 양상이 이어지면 선거 관심도가 올라가고 부동층의 투표 참여율이 증가할 가능성이 크다”고 했다.)

item.title: Busan Election Commission Requests Investigation into Han Dong-hoon’s ‘Volunteer Lounge’ (부산 선관위, 한동훈 ‘자원봉사자 쉼터’ 수사 의뢰)
item.description:
Busan Election Commission Requests Investigation into Han Dong-hoon’s ‘Volunteer Lounge’ (부산 선관위, 한동훈 ‘자원봉사자 쉼터’ 수사 의뢰)

The Busan Metropolitan Election Commission has requested a police investigation into allegations surrounding the ‘volunteer lounge’ of independent candidate Han Dong-hoon, who is running in the Busan Buk-gu Gap National Assembly by-election, it was reported on the 29th. (부산시선거관리위원회가 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거에 출마한 무소속 한동훈 후보의 ‘자원봉사자 쉼터’ 의혹에 대해 경찰에 수사 의뢰한 것으로 29일 전해졌다.)

A Busan Election Commission official told this newspaper in a phone call on the same day, “With the intention of clarifying whether a facility similar to an election office was set up and operated for a specific candidate, we requested an investigation from the Busan Metropolitan Police Agency on the 28th.” The Busan Election Commission had conducted an on-site inspection of the volunteer lounge in Deokcheon-dong, Buk-gu, Busan, on the 24th. (부산선관위 관계자는 이날 본지 통화에서 “특정 후보자를 위해 선거사무소 유사기관을 설치·운영했는지 밝혀달라는 취지로 지난 28일 부산경찰청에 수사 의뢰했다”고 말했다. 부산선관위는 지난 24일 부산 북구 덕천동의 자원봉사자 쉼터를 현장 조사했었다.)

Article 89 of the Public Official Election Act prohibits the establishment of similar facilities for a candidate outside of legal election offices. A request for investigation is a lower-level measure than a formal complaint. The police are expected to investigate whether Han’s campaign was involved in setting up the volunteer lounge. (공직선거법 제89조는 법정 선거사무소 외에는 후보자를 위해 유사 시설을 설립할 수 없도록 하고 있다. 수사 의뢰는 고발보다 한 단계 낮은 조치다. 경찰은 한 후보 측이 자원봉사자 쉼터를 만드는 데 관여했는지 등을 수사할 것으로 보인다.)

In response, Han’s camp stated, “We are currently operating only the election office and the campaign finance office in accordance with the Public Official Election Act,” and added, “The lounge has nothing to do with the election campaign.” On the same day, Han rebutted on Facebook, saying, “As soon as the Democratic Party called for an investigation request, the Election Commission requested an investigation into a matter completely unrelated to the Han Dong-hoon campaign on the first day of early voting.” (이에 대해 한 후보 측은 “현재 공직선거법에 따라 선거사무실과 후원회 사무실만 운영 중”이라며 “쉼터는 선거 캠프와 무관하다”고 밝혔다. 한 후보는 이날 페이스북에 “민주당이 수사 의뢰하라고 하자, 선관위는 한동훈 캠프와 전혀 무관한 사안을 사전투표 첫날에 수사 의뢰했다”고 반박했다.)

Democratic Party Secretary-General Cho Seung-rae said at a press briefing on the 25th, “We hope the Election Commission will swiftly investigate and judge illegal election activities through the installation of similar offices and request an investigation from investigative agencies.” Democratic Party candidate Ha Jung-woo, who is competing against Han, raised suspicions about the operation of a similar election office during a TV debate on the 28th. (더불어민주당 조승래 사무총장은 지난 25일 기자간담회에서 “선관위는 유사 사무소 설치를 통한 불법 선거운동에 대해 신속하게 조사·판단해 수사기관에 수사 의뢰를 하길 바란다”고 했다. 한 후보와 경쟁하고 있는 민주당 하정우 후보는 지난 28일 TV 토론에서 유사 선거사무소 운영 의혹을 제기했다.)

item.title: 11.6% on First Day of Early Voting, Highest for a Local Election (사전투표 첫날 11.6%, 지방선거 최고치)
item.description:
11.6% on First Day of Early Voting, Highest for a Local Election (사전투표 첫날 11.6%, 지방선거 최고치)

On the 29th, the first day of early voting for the June 3 local elections, the national turnout was recorded at 11.6%. This is a 1.42 percentage point increase compared to the 2022 local elections (10.18%), marking the highest among all local elections. Both ruling and opposition parties, viewing turnout as a decisive factor in battlegrounds like Seoul, Busan, South Gyeongsang, and South Chungcheong, have launched a final all-out effort. (6·3 지방선거 사전투표 첫날인 29일 전국 투표율이 11.6%로 집계됐다. 2022년 지방선거(10.18%)와 비교해 1.42%포인트 증가한 것으로 역대 지방선거 중 가장 높았다. 여야는 서울·부산·경남·충남 등 접전지에서 투표율이 승패를 가를 것으로 보고 막판 총력전에 나섰다.)

The Democratic Party of Korea emphasized that stock prices have risen since the launch of the Lee Jae-myung administration while also encouraging voter participation among their supporters through a "judgment on the insurrection" narrative. Democratic Party leader Jeong Cheong-rae said during a campaign rally in Seoul, "Those who are pleased with their stock account should vote for the Democratic Party candidate," and "If you support President Lee Jae-myung, please choose the Democratic Party candidate." Representative Jeong added, "Power does not come from the barrel of a gun but from the ballot box. Voting leads to victory." Floor leader Han Byeong-do, visiting North Jeolla for the second consecutive day—a region that has become a battleground due to the rise of independent candidate Kim Gwan-yeong—said, "Only by achieving an overwhelming victory in the local elections can the president gain strength." (더불어민주당은 이재명 정부 출범 후 주가가 상승했다는 점을 강조하는 한편 ‘내란 심판론’으로 지지층의 투표 참여를 독려했다. 정청래 민주당 대표는 서울 유세에서 “주식 계좌를 보며 흐뭇한 분들은 민주당 후보에게 투표해달라”며 “이재명 대통령을 지지한다면 민주당 후보를 선택해달라”고 했다. 정 대표는 “권력은 총구에서 나오지 않고 투표장에서 나온다. 투표하면 이긴다”고 했다. 한병도 원내대표는 무소속 김관영 후보의 약진으로 접전 지역이 된 전북을 연이틀 찾아 “지방선거에서 압도적 승리를 해야만 대통령이 힘을 받는다”고 했다.)

The People Power Party appealed for checks on the Democratic Party, which controls both legislation and administration. They argued that the ruling party's push for a special counsel bill on "fabricated indictments," which could withdraw prosecutions related to President Lee Jae-myung, must be stopped. People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyeok stated during a rally, "South Korea is just a few centimeters away from falling off a cliff," and urged, "Please protect South Korea." Floor leader Song Eon-seok said in a text message to party members, "The fate of the nation depends on how many supporters come out to vote during the two days of early voting and the single day of regular voting." (국민의힘은 입법과 행정을 장악한 민주당을 견제해 달라고 호소했다. 이재명 대통령 관련 사건을 공소취소할 수 있는 ‘조작기소’ 특검법을 추진하는 여당을 막아야 한다는 것이다. 장동혁 국민의힘 대표는 이날 유세에서 “대한민국이 낭떠러지로 떨어지기까지 몇 센티미터 남지 않았다”며 “대한민국을 지켜 달라”고 했다. 송언석 원내대표는 당원들에게 보낸 문자메시지에서 “사전투표 이틀과 본투표 하루 동안 지지자들이 얼마나 많이 투표장에 나오느냐에 나라의 운명이 걸려 있다”고 했다.)

Meanwhile, on the same day, police conducted raids on the Seoul Infrastructure Headquarters and other entities in connection with the collapse at the Seosomun elevated road demolition site in Seoul. This occurred just one day after President Lee Jae-myung, during a meeting of senior presidential secretaries, mentioned the Seosomun accident and the issue of missing rebar at the Samsung Station GTX project, stating, "A thorough investigation is necessary." (이런 가운데 경찰이 이날 서울 서소문 고가차도 철거 현장 붕괴 사고와 관련해 서울시 서울도시기반시설본부 등에 대해 압수수색에 나섰다. 전날 청와대 수석보좌관 회의에서 이재명 대통령이 서소문 사고와 삼성역 GTX 철근 누락 문제를 언급하며 “철저한 조사가 필요하다”고 밝힌 지 하루 만이다.)

According to the National Election Commission, the regional early voting rates on the first day were highest in South Jeolla (22.31%), followed by North Jeolla (19.39%) and Gangwon (14.37%), with Daegu recording the lowest at 9.02%. (중앙선거관리위원회에 따르면 지역별 첫날 사전투표율은 전남(22.31%), 전북(19.39%), 강원(14.37%) 순이었고, 대구가 9.02%로 가장 낮았다.)

item.title: "Only half stamped, is that okay?" Controversy over Lee’s ballot exposure (“도장 반만 찍혔는데 괜찮나” 李 투표지 노출 논란)
item.description:
"Only half stamped, is that okay?" Controversy over Lee’s ballot exposure (“도장 반만 찍혔는데 괜찮나” 李 투표지 노출 논란)

President Lee Jae-myung sparked controversy as he briefly brought his marked ballot out of the voting booth during early voting for the June 3 local elections. (이재명 대통령이 6·3 지방선거 사전 투표를 하면서 자신이 기표(記票)한 투표 용지를 기표소에서 들고 나오는 상황이 잠시 벌어져 논란이 됐다.)

On the first day of early voting, the 29th, President Lee visited the polling station at Samcheong-dong Community Center near the presidential office Cheong Wa Dae with First Lady Kim Hye-kyung to cast his early ballot. President Lee voted as an absentee voter for his registered address in Gyeyang-eul, Incheon. (이 대통령은 사전 투표 첫날인 29일 김혜경 여사와 함께 청와대 인근 삼청동 주민센터의 투표소를 찾아 사전 투표를 했다. 이 대통령은 주소지인 인천 계양을 지역에 대한 관외 투표를 했다.)

After receiving a ballot and entering the booth, President Lee emerged shortly and asked, "Where is the staff?" looking for the early voting supervisor from the National Election Commission. He inquired, "It's not fully stamped in a circle but only half stamped like this—is that okay?" When the supervisor responded, "You shouldn't show (the ballot)," President Lee motioned, saying, "Come here," calling the supervisor closer, and asked again, "I'm asking if this is okay since it's only half stamped. It won't be invalid or anything, right? Because it's only half stamped." After the supervisor replied, "It's fine," President Lee returned to the booth to finish voting and then placed the ballot into the ballot box with Ms. Kim. <<> When President Lee was speaking with the supervisor, the ballot was not folded, and this scene was captured by cameras from media outlets, including broadcasters, positioned at a distance. As a result, the opposition raised criticisms, stating that "President Lee exposed the ballot, violating election laws." <<> People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk said, "He even blatantly engaged in illegal electioneering in front of broadcast cameras," calling it "grounds for impeachment for violating the president's duty of neutrality in elections." Floor leader Song Eon-seok stated, "The publicly revealed ballot should be treated as invalid," adding, "He acted in a haughty manner, intoxicated by a sense of privilege, openly ignoring the election law." The election law stipulates that marked ballots cannot be disclosed, and any ballot that is disclosed is considered invalid. It also prohibits filming the ballot inside the voting booth. <<> The Cheong Wa Dae side said, "The president did not show the ballot to the supervisor," and described it as "a mere incident with no legal issues." An official from the National Election Commission stated, "After checking with the supervisor in question, we confirmed that he did not see the voting contents, so it was not treated as invalid." <<> However, the opposition reacted, saying, "The election commission gave a predetermined answer to cover up the president's violation of election law." One official commented, "It's now impossible to find and invalidate the ballot marked by the president," adding, "It would be difficult for the election commission to say otherwise." <<> The People Power Party has recently criticized President Lee for holding consecutive events in regions considered battlegrounds for the June 3 election, calling it "blatant interference in the election." President Lee visited the competitive Yeongnam region five times this month alone. Starting with a shipbuilding industry meeting in Ulsan on the 13th, he held various events in Daegu on the 15th, Gimhae in South Gyeongsang on the 23rd, Changwon in South Gyeongsang on the 26th, and Busan on the 27th. Regarding the fact that the 'Sea Day' event, originally on the 31st, was moved up to the 27th, voices from the opposition suggested, "Could the schedule have been adjusted because early voting starts on the 29th?" (투표 용지를 받아 기표소로 들어갔던 이 대통령은 잠시 뒤 기표소에서 나와 “관리원이 어디 있죠”라며 선관위 사전 투표 관리관을 찾았다. 이 대통령은 “이게 동그랗게 완전하게 안 찍히고 이런 식으로 반만 찍히는데 괜찮나요”라고 물었다. 관리관이 “(투표 용지를) 보여주시면 안 되고요”라고 하자, 이 대통령은 “이리 와보세요”라고 손짓을 해 관리관을 가까이 부른 뒤 “이게 이렇게밖에 안 찍혀서 괜찮냐고요. 무효가 되거나 그러지 않고요, 반밖에 안 찍혀서”라고 재차 물었다. 관리관이 “괜찮습니다”라고 답하자, 이 대통령은 다시 기표소로 들어가 투표를 마친 뒤 김 여사와 함께 투표함에 투표 용지를 넣었다.)

item.title: Seoul City Raided on First Day of Early Voting... Opposition Calls It "Election Rigging Like Ulsan's" (사전투표날 서울시 압수수색… 野 “울산 선거공작 같은 관권 개입”)
item.description:
Seoul City Raided on First Day of Early Voting... Opposition Calls It "Election Rigging Like Ulsan's" (사전투표날 서울시 압수수색… 野 “울산 선거공작 같은 관권 개입”)

On the 29th, the first day of early voting for the June 3 local elections, police raided the Seoul City Infrastructure Headquarters in connection with the collapse of the Seosomun Overpass demolition. This came just a day after President Lee Jae-myung mentioned the Seosomun overpass accident and the missing rebar at GTX Samsung Station during a senior aide meeting at the Blue House on the 28th, stating that "a thorough investigation is necessary." The Democratic Party of Korea, which has been pushing the theory of Seoul City's responsibility, called for "strict investigation," while the People Power Party denounced it as "blatant election interference." <<> The Seoul Metropolitan Police Agency's Wide-area Crime Investigation Unit announced that it conducted raids on seven locations this morning, including the Seoul City Infrastructure Headquarters, the demolition contractor Heunghwa Construction, subcontractors, and the site office. They are suspected of violating the Criminal Act (negligent homicide and injury), the Serious Accidents Punishment Act, and the Occupational Safety and Health Act. Police plan to secure safety management plans and work order records to determine the cause of the accident and assign responsibility. <<> The accident occurred on the 26th during the demolition of the Seosomun Overpass in Seoul. The contractor discovered that part of the deck had sunk by about 2.9 cm during demolition and halted work, but the structure later collapsed during a safety inspection. The accident killed three people, including the supervision team leader, the site manager, and a structural engineer, and injured three others. Police formed a dedicated investigation team of around 50 members on the day of the accident. <<> Democratic Party floor leader Han Byung-do, during a meeting of the central election committee, targeted People Power Party Seoul mayoral candidate Oh Se-hoon, saying, "Protecting the lives and safety of the people is the foundation of administration," adding, "We can no longer entrust the safety of 10 million Seoul citizens to a candidate who can't even get the basics right." Democratic Party Seoul mayoral candidate Jung Won-oh also issued a statement, saying, "I will make citizen safety the top priority of Seoul city administration," and stressed, "The cause and responsibility of the accident must be thoroughly uncovered, and anyone involved must be held strictly accountable." <<> The Democratic Party is intensifying its late-campaign offensive by highlighting Oh's city administration and Seoul's safety management systems. Earlier, regarding the missing rebar at GTX Samsung Station, the Democratic Party had convened the National Assembly's Public Administration and Security Committee and the Land, Infrastructure, and Transport Committee to argue Oh's responsibility, while the People Power Party countered that after the contractor became aware of the issue, Seoul City reported it to the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport. In response, Oh proposed a debate with Jung Won-oh, but Jung refused, saying, "Would a debate between non-experts solve anything?" <<> People Power Party floor leader Song Eon-seok cited the case of former Ulsan Mayor Kim Ki-hyun (now a People Power Party lawmaker) during the 2018 local elections under the Moon Jae-in administration, when police raided his office just before the election. Song said, "I hope this is not the second season of Blue House election interference." Kim lost that election, and while those involved in the subsequent investigation were found guilty in the first trial, they were acquitted by the second trial and the Supreme Court last year due to lack of evidence. The People Power Party argued, "While determining the cause of the accident is necessary, the raid on Seoul City the day after the president's remarks, and on the first day of early voting, amounts to an electioneering abuse of state power." <<> Candidate Oh Se-hoon also held a press conference, stating, "The day before early voting, the president effectively ordered an investigation, and the raid happened the very next day," adding, "With the Seoul mayoral race becoming extremely tight, I cannot shake the suspicion that this is an attempt to shake up the election." Oh further remarked, "They won't be able to seize the hearts of voters." <<> Seoul City claims it had submitted documents such as safety management plans, bidding and ordering contracts, and on-site CCTV footage to the police before the raid. Seoul City stated, "We understand the raid as part of the investigative process to determine the cause of the accident and are actively cooperating as the contracting authority." Immediately after the incident, the Ministry of Employment and Labor, along with the police, has also been investigating whether safety management plans were implemented. (6·3 지방선거 사전투표 첫날인 29일 경찰이 서울 서소문 고가차도 철거 붕괴 사고와 관련해 서울시 도시기반시설본부를 압수수색했다. 이재명 대통령이 28일 청와대 수석보좌관 회의에서 서소문 고가차도 사고와 GTX(수도권광역급행철도) 삼성역 철근 누락을 언급하며 “철저한 조사가 필요하다”고 밝힌 지 하루 만이다. 서울시 책임론을 주장해 온 더불어민주당은 “엄정 수사”를 촉구했고, 국민의힘은 “노골적 선거 개입”이라고 반발했다.)

item.title: Early Voting Rate on Second Day of Local Elections at 8 AM: 12.64%... Up 1.48%p from Four Years Ago (지선 둘째날 사전투표율 오전 8시 12.64%…4년 전보다 1.48%p↑)
item.description:
Early Voting Rate on Second Day of Local Elections at 8 AM: 12.64%... Up 1.48%p from Four Years Ago (지선 둘째날 사전투표율 오전 8시 12.64%…4년 전보다 1.48%p↑ )

The National Election Commission announced on the 30th, the second day of early voting for the June 3 local elections, that the turnout rate stood at 12.64% as of 7 AM. (중앙선거관리위원회는 6·3 지방선거 사전 투표 둘째날인 30일 오전 7시 현재 투표율이 12.64%로 집계됐다고 밝혔다.)

In the early voting that began at 6 AM the previous day, 5,645,207 out of a total of 44,649,908 eligible voters had cast their ballots. (전날 오전 6시부터 진행된 사전투표에서 전체 유권자 4464만9908명 가운데 564만5207명이 투표를 마쳤다.)

This is 1.45 percentage points higher than the early voting turnout rate at the same time during the 8th local elections in 2022 (10.66%). On the other hand, it is 4.22 percentage points lower than the same-time turnout rate in last year's 22nd general election (16.86%) and 8.55 percentage points lower than the 21st presidential election (21.19%). (이는 2022년 제8회 지방선거의 사전투표 동시간대 투표율(10.66%)과 비교하면 1.45%포인트 높다. 반면 지난해 22대 총선 당시 같은 시간 투표율(16.86%)보다는 4.22%포인트, 21대 대통령선거(21.19%)보다는 8.55%포인트 낮은 수준이다.)

The region with the highest turnout so far is South Jeolla Province (24.12%), followed by North Jeolla Province (20.98%). (현재까지 투표율이 가장 높은 지역은 전남(24.12%)이다. 전북(20.98%) 등이 뒤를 이었다.)

The lowest turnout was in Daegu at 9.80%. Other regions include Gangwon Province 15.55%, Gwangju 15.37%, Sejong 13.58%, South Gyeongsang Province 13.45%, North Chungcheong Province 13.02%, Jeju 12.99%, North Gyeongsang Province 12.76%, South Chungcheong Province 12.47%, Seoul 12.21%, Ulsan 11.91%, Daejeon 11.72%, Busan 11.52%, Incheon 11.15%, and Gyeonggi Province 10.76%. (가장 낮은 곳은 9.80%의 대구였다. 이 밖에 강원 15.55%, 광주 15.37%, 세종 13.58%, 경남 13.45%, 충북 13.02%, 제주 12.99%, 경북 12.76%, 충남 12.47%, 서울 12.21%, 울산 11.91%, 대전 11.72%, 부산 11.52%, 인천 11.15%, 경기 10.76% 순으로 이었다.)

Early voting, which began at 6 AM on the 29th, will continue until 6 PM on the same day. (29일 오전 6시 시작된 사전투표는 이날 오후 6시까지 이뤄진다.)

To participate in early voting, voters must bring their ID and visit an early voting station. A total of 3,571 polling stations have been set up nationwide. The locations of polling stations can be checked on the National Election Commission website (www.nec.go.kr) or via the representative phone number (☎1390). (사전투표에 참여하려면 신분증을 반드시 지참하고 사전투표소를 방문해야 한다. 전국에 총 3571개 투표소가 설치됐다. 투표소 위치는 선관위 홈페이지(www.nec.go.kr)나 대표전화(☎1390)로 확인할 수 있다.)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk: “Lee’s voter turnout encouragement is also division… Who is harming our lives?” (장동혁 “李, 투표 독려도 갈라치기…삶 해치는 게 누구인가”)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk: “Lee’s voter turnout encouragement is also division… Who is harming our lives?” (장동혁 “李, 투표 독려도 갈라치기…삶 해치는 게 누구인가”)

On the second day of early voting for the June 3 local elections, Jang Dong-hyuk, leader of the People Power Party, criticized President Lee Jae-myung’s message urging voter turnout, stating, “Even encouraging voter turnout is being turned into a tool for division.” (6·3 지방 선거 사전투표 둘째날인 30일 장동혁 국민의힘 대표는 이재명 대통령의 투표 독려 메시지를 두고 “투표 독려까지 갈라치기 하는 것”이라고 했다.)

In a Facebook post that day, Representative Jang wrote, “Lee Jae-myung, even encouraging voter turnout is an act of division. He claims, ‘Abstaining from voting is not neutrality but siding with those who harm our lives and community.’” He added, “Has he been receiving some kind of ‘mirror therapy’ lately? Who is it that harms our lives with a ‘real estate hell’ and a ‘triple-high crisis’?” (장 대표는 이날 페이스북 글에서 “이재명, 투표 독려까지 갈라치기다. ‘투표 포기는 중립이 아니라 내 삶과 공동체를 해치는 그들을 편드는 것’이란다”라며 “요즘 어디서 ‘거울 치료’라도 받고 있나? ‘부동산 지옥’, ‘3고 지옥’으로 내 삶을 해치는 게 누구?”라고 적었다.)

Representative Jang continued, “Who is it that destroys communities through manipulation and agitation, from mad cow disease, THAAD, Fukushima, to Starbucks? Isn’t it Lee Jae-myung and the Democratic Party who are ‘those harming our lives and community’?” He added, “So it sounds like we should vote for the People Power Party. I guess I should have taken a closer look at Lee Jae-myung’s ballot yesterday.” (장 대표는 “광우병, 사드, 후쿠시마에 이어 스타벅스까지, 조작과 선동으로 공동체를 파괴하는 게 누구? 이재명과 민주당이야말로 ‘내 삶과 공동체를 해치는 그들’ 아닌가”라며 “그러면 국민의힘 찍으라는 소리네. 어제 이재명 투표용지를 잘 살펴볼 걸 그랬네”라고 했다.)

President Lee posted on his X account that morning, stating, “Voting is the lifeline of democracy,” and “Giving up on voting is the same as giving up on the future of me and my family.” (이 대통령은 이날 오전 자신의 X(엑스) 계정에 “투표는 민주주의의 생명줄이다”라며 “투표를 포기하는 것은 나와 가족의 미래를 포기하는 것과 같다”는 내용의 글을 올렸다.)

President Lee said, “Abstaining from voting is not neutrality but siding with those who harm my life and community.” (이 대통령은 “투표 포기는 중립이 아니라 내 삶과 공동체를 해치는 그들을 편드는 것”이라고 했다.)

The People Power Party has escalated its offensive, accusing President Lee’s actions during early voting the previous day—when he stepped out of the voting booth holding his ballot to ask an election official a question—of being an act of “government-backed electioneering.” (국민의힘은 전날 사전투표에 참여한 이 대통령이 기표 도중 투표용지를 들고 나와 선거사무원에게 문의한 것과 관련해 ‘관권 선거’라며 공세 수위를 높이고 있다)

At that time, President Lee left the voting booth, sought out an official, and asked, “It didn’t stamp the full circle, only half; is that okay?” After being informed that it was fine, he returned to complete his vote. (.당시 이 대통령은 기표소에서 나와 관리원을 찾은 뒤 “동그랗게 안 찍히고 반만 찍혔는데 괜찮나”는 취지로 질의했고, 괜찮다는 안내를 받은 뒤 다시 들어가 투표를 마쳤다.)

Park Sung-hoon, head of the Public Relations Team for the People Power Party’s Central Election Committee, argued in a statement that day, “This is a clear violation of the Public Official Election Act, and it is a highly orchestrated form of election interference, signaling to his supporters and Democratic Party voters, ‘Vote the same way I did for the Democratic Party candidate.’” (박성훈 국민의힘 중앙선대위 공보단장은 오늘 논평에서 “이는 명백한 공직선거법 위반이며, 본인의 지지층과 민주당 유권자들을 향해 ‘내가 찍은 민주당 후보를 똑같이 찍으라’고 타전한 고도의 기획형 선거 개입”이라고 주장했다.)

item.title: President Lee: "Abstaining from Voting Means Taking Sides with Those Harming Our Community" (李대통령 “투표 포기, 공동체 해치는 그들 편드는 것”)
item.description:
President Lee: "Abstaining from Voting Means Taking Sides with Those Harming Our Community" (李대통령 “투표 포기, 공동체 해치는 그들 편드는 것”)

On the second day of early voting for the 9th National Simultaneous Local Elections, President Lee Jae-myung urged citizens to vote, stating, "Giving up voting is like giving up the future of yourself and your family." (이재명 대통령은 제9회 전국동시지방선거 사전투표 둘째 날인 30일 “투표를 포기하는 것은 나와 가족의 미래를 포기하는 것과 같다”며 투표를 독려했다.)

In a post titled "Let's Definitely Vote" uploaded to X (formerly Twitter) on the same day, President Lee wrote, "Voting is the lifeline of democracy." He added, "Abstaining from voting is not neutrality; it means taking sides with those who harm my life and our community." (이 대통령은 이날 엑스(X·옛 트위터)에 올린 ‘꼭 투표합시다’라는 제목의 글에서 “투표는 민주주의의 생명줄”이라고 적었다. 이 대통령은 “투표 포기는 중립이 아니라 내 삶과 공동체를 해치는 그들을 편드는 것”이라고 했다.)

Earlier, on the first day of early voting, President Lee visited a polling station set up at Samcheong-dong Community Center in Jongno-gu, Seoul, near the presidential office, along with his wife Kim Hye-kyung to cast their votes. <<> According to the National Election Commission, as of 9 a.m. on the same day, the national average early voter turnout was recorded at 13.35%. The region with the highest voter turnout nationwide was South Jeolla Province (25.32%), followed by North Jeolla Province (22.08%) and Gangwon Province (16.38%), which ranked third highest. (앞서 이 대통령은 사전투표 첫날인 전날 김혜경 여사와 함께 청와대 인근인 서울 종로구 삼청동 주민센터에 마련된 투표소를 찾아 투표했다.)

Following closely, Gwangju recorded 16.20%. In contrast, the lowest turnout was in Daegu at 10.37%, followed by Gyeonggi Province (11.40%), Incheon (11.81%), and Busan (12.11%). The Seoul region's voter turnout stood at 12.89%, below the national average. (중앙선거관리위원회에 따르면 이날 오전 9시 현재 전국 평균 사전투표율은 13.35%로 집계됐다. 현재 전국에서 가장 투표율이 높은 지역은 전남(25.32%)이며, 전북(22.08%)에 이어 강원(16.38%)이 전국에서 세 번째로 높은 투표율을 보이고 있다.)

item.title: Ruling and Opposition Leadership Go All-Out in Southern Regions and Gangwon on Final Weekend Before June 3 Elections (與野 지도부, 6·3 선거 마지막 주말 남부·강원서 총력전)
item.description:
Ruling and Opposition Leadership Go All-Out in Southern Regions and Gangwon on Final Weekend Before June 3 Elections (與野 지도부, 6·3 선거 마지막 주말 남부·강원서 총력전)

On May 30, the final weekend before the June 3 local elections, the leadership of both the ruling and opposition parties will continue their campaigns in the southern regions and Gangwon, respectively. As the number of competitive districts where support rates for candidates are narrowing increases in the final stage, both the Democratic Party of Korea and the People Power Party view voter turnout among their support bases and undecided voters as a key factor in determining the outcome, and they are focusing their efforts on boosting turnout starting from the early voting phase. <<> Jung Cheong-rae, acting leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, held a campaign rally on the morning of May 30 at Wando Traditional Market in South Jeolla Province alongside Min Hyeong-bae, candidate for the integrated mayoralty of Gwangju and South Jeolla, and Woo Hong-seop, candidate for Wando County Governor. <<> Acting leader Jung stated, "This local election is an election to choose local workers, but the most important thing is that it is an election to empower President Lee Jae-myung," adding, "This local election is an election to choose local workers, but it is also an election to extinguish the embers of insurrection." <<> Acting leader Jung promised support for local issues such as a kim foundation, the abalone industry, and the Geumil Bridge, and said, "Even to empower President Lee Jae-myung, please be sure to elect Woo Hong-seop as Wando County Governor." <<> After touring South Jeolla areas including Jindo, Jangheung, and Suncheon, acting leader Jung plans to head to Hadong in South Gyeongsang Province later in the afternoon to attend a support rally for Je Yoon-kyung, candidate for Hadong County Governor. On May 31, he plans to visit Gurye, Geumsan, Yeongdong, and Boeun. <<> Democratic Party floor leader Han Byeong-do will visit South Chungcheong and North Jeolla provinces. Floor leader Han will support candidates starting with Maeng Jeong-ho, candidate for Seosan Mayor, followed by Kang Cheol-min, candidate for Taean County Governor, Kim Young-bin, candidate for the Gongju-Buyeo-Cheongyang parliamentary district, and Kim Jeong-seop, candidate for Gongju Mayor. <<> Afterward, he will head to North Jeolla to meet with Park Ji-won, candidate for the Gunsan-Gimje-Buan parliamentary district, and help with campaigning. <<> Floor leader Han has been steadily visiting North Jeolla since May 21 to appeal for support. In North Jeolla, a traditional stronghold of the Democratic Party, Lee Won-taek, the party's candidate for North Jeolla Governor, and Kim Gwan-young, another Democratic Party candidate for North Jeolla Governor, are in a close race. <<> People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk is focusing on Gangwon Province. Leader Jang plans to visit Chuncheon alongside lawmaker Jin Jong-oh, who is from Chuncheon, for a campaign rally. Former President Park Geun-hye had previously held a support rally in Gangwon. <<> People Power Party floor leader Song Eon-seok will visit North Gyeongsang Province and Daegu. Floor leader Song will support Lee Cheol-woo, candidate for North Gyeongsang Governor, at the Hwanggeum Market in Gimcheon, North Gyeongsang, and then proceed with early voting. Afterward, he plans to visit the Pyeonghwa Market in Gimcheon to appeal for support for Bae Nak-ho, candidate for Gimcheon Mayor. (6·3 지방선거을 앞둔 마지막 주말인 30일 여야 지도부는 각각 남부 지역과 강원을 찾아 유세를 이어간다. 선거 막판 여야 후보 지지율이 좁혀지는 접전 지역이 늘면서 여야 모두 지지층과 부동층의 투표율이 승패를 가를 변수가 될 것으로 보고 더불어민주당과 국민의힘은 사전 투표 단계에서부터 지지층의 투표율을 끌어올리는 데 총력을 기울이고 있다.)

item.title: Democratic Party Goes All Out in Pyeongtaek, Accuses “Fake Democratic Party Candidate of Misleading People… No Merger” (평택 총력전 나선 민주당 “가짜 민주당 후보 사람들 현혹…합당 없다”)
item.description:
Democratic Party Goes All Out in Pyeongtaek, Accuses “Fake Democratic Party Candidate of Misleading People… No Merger” (평택 총력전 나선 민주당 “가짜 민주당 후보 사람들 현혹…합당 없다”)

On the final day of early voting for the June 3 by-elections, the Democratic Party of Korea visited the key battleground of Pyeongtaek, Gyeonggi Province, to fully support Kim Yong-nam, the Democratic Party candidate in the Pyeongtaek-eul National Assembly by-election. (6.3 지방선거 사전투표 마지막 날 더불어민주당이 격전지인 경기 평택시를 찾아 김용남 민주당 평택을 국회의원 재선거 후보 총력 지원에 나섰다.)

Cho Seung-rae, Secretary-General of the Democratic Party of Korea, held an on-site headquarters meeting on the morning of the 30th at the election camp of Democratic candidate Kim Yong-nam in Anjung-eup, Pyeongtaek, Gyeonggi Province. Targeting Cho Kuk, candidate of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party, he stated, “A fake Democratic Party candidate is misleading people as if he were the real candidate.” (조승래 더불어민주당 사무총장은 30일 오전 경기 평택시 안중읍에 위치한 김용남 민주당 후보 선거캠프에서 현장 본부장단회의를 열고 조국 조국혁신당 후보를 겨냥해 “가짜 민주당 후보가 마치 진짜 후보인 것처럼 사람들을 현혹하고 있다”고 했다.)

Secretary-General Cho said, “The candidate selected by President Lee Jae-myung and nominated by the Democratic Party is Kim Yong-nam,” adding, “Though it’s unlikely, if you vote for the fake Democratic Party, the People Power Party could win. You must support the real Democratic Party.” (조 총장은 “이재명 대통령이 선택하고 민주당이 공천한 후보는 김용남”이라며 “혹시 그럴 일은 없겠지만 가짜 민주당을 찍으면 국민의힘이 당선될 수도 있다. 진짜 민주당을 지원해야 한다”고 했다.)

He also noted, “Recently, the People Power Party has mobilized former presidents to rally conservatives,” and “There appears to be such movement in the Pyeongtaek-eul area as well. Therefore, voting for the fake Democratic Party could put Mr. Kim at risk.” (또 “최근 국민의힘이 전직 대통령들을 동원해 보수결집에 나섰다”며 “평택을 지역에서도 그런 움직임이 있는 것으로 보인다. 그렇기 때문에 가짜 민주당을 찍으면 (김 후보가) 위태로울 수도 있다”고 했다.)

Secretary-General Cho urged, “You must overwhelmingly elect Mr. Kim in Pyeongtaek so that the Lee Jae-myung administration can solidify its governance,” and “Please support Kim Yong-nam, the real Democratic Party candidate.” (조 총장은 “평택에서 김 후보를 압도적으로 당선시켜 주셔야 이재명 정부가 국정 운영을 튼튼하게 할 수 있다”며 “진짜 민주당 후보 김용남을 지원해달라”고 했다.)

On this day, candidate Cho Kuk attended a farewell gathering for the Anjung Nonghyup Donginhoe group outing, visited the Pyeongtaek Mayor’s Cup tennis tournament, and attended a community sports baseball tournament. (이날 조국 후보는 안중농협 동인회 야유회 배웅 인사와 평택시장배 테니스대회, 생활체육 야구대회 방문 일정을 소화했다.)

Candidate Cho posted on Facebook, “Today is the last day of early voting. Please give me, Cho Kuk, the chance to work.” He continued, “More than 3,000 volunteers have voluntarily gathered to help Cho Kuk, the candidate for Pyeongtaek-eul National Assembly member,” and “These volunteers, who come together of their own will without expectation of reward, are the strongest driving force of this election. To repay their dedication and sincerity, I will definitely win.” (조 후보는 이날 페이스북에 “사전투표 마지막 날이다. 조국에게 일할 기회를 모아달라”고 했다. 이어 “조국 평택을 국회의원 후보를 돕기 위해 자발적으로 모여든 자원봉사 연인원이 3000명을 넘어섰다”며 “대가 없이, 스스로의 뜻으로 모여드는 자원봉사자들이야말로 이번 선거의 가장 강력한 동력이다. 그 정성과 진심에 보답하기 위해서라도 반드시 당선되겠다”고 했다.)

Candidate Cho plans to attend the Pyeongtaek Park Golf Tournament and the family gathering of the Anjung Uri Moimhoe group. Afterwards, he will conduct street campaigning in the Cheongbuk New Town and Godeok International New Town areas, before visiting a citizen-participation band performance at the outdoor stage in Hambaksan Central Park. (조 후보는 평택 파크골프대회와 안중 우리모임회 가족모임에 참석할 예정이다. 이후 청북신도시와 고덕국제신도시 일대에서 골목 유세를 진행한 뒤 함박산중앙공원 야외공연장에서 열리는 시민 참여 밴드 공연장을 찾는다.)

item.title: "Stop Lee’s Election Interference": Opposition Visits Police in Protest Over Seoul City Hall Raid (“李 선거개입 중단하라”…野, ‘서울시청 압수수색’ 경찰 항의 방문)
item.description:
Lawmakers from the People Power Party on the National Assembly's Public Administration and Security Committee visited the Seoul Metropolitan Police Agency to protest the police's raid on Seoul City Hall in connection with the investigation into the collapse of the Seosomun elevated roadway. (국민의힘 소속 국회 행정안전위원회 의원들이 경찰이 서소문 고가 차도 붕괴 사고 수사와 관련해서 서울시청을 압수수색한 것에 대해 서울경찰청을 항의 방문했다.)

On the morning of the 30th, People Power Party lawmakers Cho Eun-hee, Park Choong-kwon, Ko Dong-jin, and Park Soo-min went to the Seoul Metropolitan Police Agency holding placards that read, "Stop Crown Prince Lee Jae-myung's election interference!" (30일 오전 국민의힘 조은희, 박충권, 고동진, 박수민 의원은 ‘시황제 이재명 선거개입 중단하라!’라는 문구가 적힌 피켓을 들고 서울경찰청을 찾았다.)

They stated that they met with the head of the Seoul Metropolitan Police Agency to protest, calling the police's raid on Seoul City Hall a biased investigation and political oppression targeting a specific political faction. (이들은 경찰의 서울시 압수수색이 특정 진영을 향한 편파수사와 정치탄압수사라며 서울경찰청장을 만나 항의했다고 밝혔다.)

Lawmaker Park Choong-kwon said, "The president, who is the chief officer of fair election management, has directly taken up the knife and aimed at the opposition candidate," adding, "The police have abandoned even minimal conscience and legal judgment, acting as tools of power." (박충권 의원은 “공명 선거 관리 총책임자인 대통령이 직접 칼을 쥐고 야당 후보를 겨냥했다”라며 “경찰은 최소한 양심도, 법리판단도 내팽개친 채 권력 수족을 자처했다”라고 했다.)

Lawmaker Park Soo-min criticized the raid as a selective exercise of state power, noting that despite Seoul City's cooperative stance in the investigation, it was the only entity among witnesses subjected to a raid. (박수민 의원은 서울시가 수사에 협조적이었음에도 참고인 중 유일하게 압수수색 당했다며 공권력의 선택적 집행이라고 비판했다.)

The previous day, the People Power Party mentioned a case from the Moon Jae-in administration—when police raided the office of former Ulsan Mayor Kim Ki-hyun (now a People Power Party lawmaker), who had been nominated by the party ahead of the 2018 local elections—and said, "We hope this is not the second season of Cheong Wa Dae's election interference." (국민의힘은 전날엔 문재인 정부 때인 2018년 지방선거를 앞두고 경찰이 국민의힘 공천을 받은 김기현 전 울산시장(현 국민의힘 의원) 비서실을 압수수색했던 사례를 언급하며 “청와대 선거 개입 시즌2가 아니길 바란다”고 했다.)

The Seoul Metropolitan Police Agency's Major Crime Investigation Unit raided seven locations the previous day, including the Seoul Metropolitan Government's Urban Infrastructure Headquarters, the main contractor, and subcontractors. This came just a day after President Lee Jae-myung, during a meeting of senior presidential aides at the presidential office on the 28th, mentioned the Seosomun elevated roadway collapse and missing rebar at the GTX (Great Train Express) Samsung Station, calling for a thorough investigation. (서울경찰청 광역범죄수사대는 전날 서울시 도시기반시설본부를 포함해 원청업체와 하청업체 등 7곳을 압수수색했다. 이재명 대통령이 28일 청와대 수석보좌관 회의에서 서소문 고가차도 사고와 GTX(수도권광역급행철도) 삼성역 철근 누락을 언급하며 “철저한 조사가 필요하다”고 밝힌 지 하루 만이다.)

item.title: High Early Voter Turnout… Both Ruling and Opposition Parties Claim "It Benefits Us" (높은 사전투표율에…여야 모두 “우리에게 유리”)
item.description:
On the 30th, the last day of early voting for the June 3rd local elections, both the ruling and opposition parties claimed that the higher turnout compared to previous elections "benefits us." The Democratic Party of Korea stated that historically, higher voter turnout has favored the progressive camp, while the People Power Party argued that the high turnout reflects public sentiment to check and judge the Lee Jae-myung administration. (여야는 6·3 지방선거 사전투표 마지막 날인 30일 예전 선거보다 투표율이 높자 서로 “우리에게 유리하다”고 했다. 더불어민주당은 과거 선거에서 투표율이 높을수록 진보 진영이 유리했다고 했고, 국민의힘은 높은 투표율이 이재명 정부에 대한 견제·심판 여론을 보여주는 것이라고 했다.)

As of 1:00 PM on the same day, the early voting turnout stood at 17.5%, higher than the 15.44% recorded during the same period in the 2022 local elections. On the first day alone, this election’s turnout (11.6%) was the highest among all local elections. (사전투표율은 이날 오후 1시 기준 투표율은 17.5%로 2022년 지선 동시간대 투표율(15.44%)보다 높은 상태다. 첫날 기준으로는 이번(11.6%)이 역대 지선 중 가장 높았다.)

Democratic Party Senior Spokesperson Kang Jun-hyun said in a press conference at the National Assembly, "Looking at past local, presidential, and general elections, we believe that higher early voting turnout has been encouraging for our party. This also proves that the public is highly interested in the local elections." (민주당 강준현 수석대변인은 이날 국회 기자회견에서 “그동안 지선, 대선, 총선 과정을 보면 사전투표율이 높을수록 저희 당이 고무적이었다고 생각한다”며 “그만큼 국민들이 지선에 관심이 많다는 증명이기도 하다”고 했다.)

In contrast, People Power Party Central Election Campaign Headquarters Publicity Team Leader Park Sung-hoon said in a briefing at the National Assembly, "There was a saying that higher early voting turnout favors the progressive camp, but now that early voting is well established, I think that notion has collapsed." He added, "I believe voters who want to judge the self-righteousness and arrogance of the Lee Jae-myung administration, and those seeking to protect their homes and property, are expressing their anger at the polling stations." (반면 국민의힘 박성훈 중앙선대위 공보단장은 국회 브리핑에서 “사전투표율이 높을수록 진보 진영에 유리하다는 말이 있었지만, 사전투표가 정착된 지금은 그런 말이 무너졌다고 생각한다”고 했다. 이어 “이재명 정부의 독선과 오만을 심판하겠다는 유권자들, 내 집과 재산을 지키려는 유권자들이 투표장에서 분노를 표시하고 있다고 생각한다”고 했다.)

Meanwhile, the ruling and opposition parties also clashed over former Presidents Lee Myung-bak and Park Geun-hye’s support rallies for People Power Party candidates. Senior Spokesperson Kang said, "The People Power Party, not content with a 'Yoon repeat,' is even blatantly dragging former Presidents Lee Myung-bak and Park Geun-hye into the election scene. The Lee Myung-bak administration dismantled the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries, and the Park Geun-hye administration bankrupted Hanjin Shipping. What right do these people, who undermined Busan's development momentum, have to visit Busan and become supporters of an insurrection-party?" (한편 여야는 이명박 전 대통령과 박근혜 전 대통령의 국민의힘 후보 유세 지원을 두고 이날도 충돌했다. 강 수석대변인은 “국민의힘이 ‘윤어게인’도 모자라 이명박·박근혜 전 대통령까지 노골적으로 선거판에 끌어들이고 있다”며 “이명박 정부는 해양수산부를 해체하고, 박근혜 정부는 한진해운을 파산시켰다. 부산 발전 동력을 저해했던 이들이 무슨 자격으로 부산을 찾아 내란정당 지원군이 되겠다는 것인가”라고 했다.)

In response, People Power Party Team Leader Park said, "We believe the two former presidents are acting as a focal point for conservatism, sending a strong message to the 'shy conservatives' who have been hesitant to vote, urging them to cast their ballots for the People Power Party." He added, "I think they are creating a reason for conservative voters to go to the polls." (반면 국민의힘 박 단장은 “두 전직 대통령이 보수의 구심점이 돼 그간 투표를 주저하고 있던 ‘샤이 보수’에게 국민의힘을 향해 투표해달라는 강력한 메시지를 발신하는 것이라고 생각한다”며 “보수 유권자들에게 투표 명분을 만들어주고 있다고 생각한다”고 했다.)
